2034-5220-6277-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-6277-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

512-1432-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
512-1432-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-801-3249-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-5931--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Funeral Room ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2111-6792-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4120-4968-7741.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-7741.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-7741.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
2079-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-1482-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1251-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1251-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-6893-7170.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Living Brain.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-6893-7170.notes: You can tap The Eternity Elevator for colored mana instead, if able.

176-560-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

407-478-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Swamps.
407-478-6871.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {B} for each Swamp you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Cabal Coffers and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

3020-4050-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-4050-6701.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Repeat.

3020-5147-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-5147-6701.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2043-4094-4715-4893.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

654-678-2511-6644.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1020-3689-5645-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1170-2103-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
1170-2103-6333.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

570-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

20-1527-2488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls at least one creature.
You control at least two Foods.
20-1527-2488.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gyome twice by paying {2} and sacrificing two Foods, giving Apex Altisaur and any creature an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing Apex Altisaur to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Apex Altisaur's second ability triggers, and Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers if the opposing creature's toughness is less than 0.
Resolve the Magmatic Galleon trigger, if applicable, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

686-914-5131.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-5131.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Muldrotha and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Muldrotha from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage from your graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

296-1976-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-1976-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1368-3556-5287.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1368-3556-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to mill four cards and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{W} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, blinking Dihada.
Repeat.

2034-2249-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures, one of which must have a power of one or greater.
2034-2249-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on any creature you control equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1335-2445-2744-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2445-2744-5296.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
